remarks: Welcome to Springdale! Ideally located just a 5-minute walk from the train station and moments from local shops, restaurants, and everyday conveniences, this charming 1-bedroom, 1-bath condominium offers comfortable living in a highly convenient setting. The inviting open-concept layout features an updated kitchen (2025) with newer appliances, ample cabinetry, and a breakfast bar that flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas. A sliding glass doors opens to a spacious private balcony, which is also accessible from the generously sized primary bedroom - perfect for enjoying your morning coffee or unwinding at the end of the day. An updated full bathroom and oversized laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer add to the home's functionality. With its convenient location, spacious layout, private balcony, and garage parking, this is an opportunity you won't want to miss.   Schedule your showing today, this one won't be on the market for long!
